records.speaker: In-game Help
records.heading: Game Overview
records.english: Sail the world's oceans with your companions. The world has seven regions. You lead a faction based in one of them. Each region has rival factions. Trade and battle your way to mastery of all seven seas.
records.context: Complete original Help article withits linked source definitions;T07 includes existing physical continuation202. Original menu destinations andcondition/benefit progression are reviewed together.

records.current_English: Sail the world's oceans with your companions. The world has seven regions. You lead a faction based in one of them. Each region has rival factions. Trade and battle your way to mastery of all seven seas.
records.source_Japanese_with_link_IDs:
ゲームの概要
『大航海時代４』は、仲間と共に海洋冒険を楽しむゲームです。
世界は７つの海域に分かれています。主人公はそのうちの１つの海域を拠点とする１勢力を率いています。
海域ごとに複数の勢力が存在します。主人公は交易や戦闘で他の勢力と争いながら、全海域の覇者を目指します。

records.english: Each captain has a different goal at the start. Rafael wants to become an accomplished sailor; Lil wants to make a fortune; Hodram wants to make his navy the strongest in the world. Every captain must collect all seven Proofs of Conquest and achieve supremacy in every sea region to complete the game. See [[4|Proofs of Conquest]].

ゲームの目的

［ラファエル］一人前の航海者になる。

［ホドラム］自分の海軍を世界最強にする。
どの主人公でプレイしても、「覇者の証」を７つ集めて全海域の覇者になるとゲームクリアになります。
